reports.title: Russell Brand's accusers were 'amusements in his playground of orgasms', court hears | Trial day 14
reports.description:
Warning: This episode includes graphic descriptions of alleged rape and sexual assault.  
It's day 14 of Russell Brand's rape trial in London and today his defence team finished setting out their case and the prosecution barrister presented her closing arguments.  
Ms Riel Karmy-Jones told the court that Brand saw one accuser, Woman E, as: "just a hole, a number to add to his 5,000 notches that he was marking up".  She also described his alleged victims as, 'the amusements in his playground of orgasms'.  
Ms Karmy-Jones also told the court: “Six women who have nothing to gain, who have not sought the limelight, who have not looked out for some form of publicity, who have not taken part in a documentary, not made claims for compensation. 
In this episode, Culture Correspondent Minnie Stephenson breaks down everything the jury heard today with producer Sachelle Connor.  
Brand faces three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault. He denies all charges.

reports.title: Russell Brand takes the stand and gives evidence | Trial day 12
reports.description:
Warning: This episode includes graphic descriptions of allegations of rape and sexual assault. 
Russell Brand gave evidence in court for the first time on day 12 of his rape trial. He told the court that allegations against him had had a “devastating” impact on his life, and that no one had agreed to give evidence on his behalf during the trial. 
Brand also told the court that he had been prevented from staying with his son at Great Ormond Street Hospital in London while the child underwent open-heart surgery, following the release of Channel 4's Dispatches documentary and the Times' newspaper investigation in 2023. 
In this episode, Culture Correspondent Minnie Stephenson speaks to Sachelle Connor about what the jury heard today, as the defence began their arguments. 
Brand faces three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault. He denies all the charges.

reports.title: Russell Brand's police interviews read in court | Trial day 11
reports.description:
On day 11 of Russell Brand's trial the prosecution delivered the final part of its case, before the jury heard the details of Brand's police interviews.  

In this episode our Culture Correspondent Minnie Stephenson and producer Sachelle Connor recap what happened at Southwark Crown Court today – including the Judge's decision to change the indecent assault charge against Russell Brand into an attempted indecent assault. 

Mr Justice Bennathan told jurors on Tuesday morning they should find Brand not guilty of the indecent assault allegation after he had concluded “there was insufficient evidence” to support the charge. 

He also told the jury that a charge of attempted indecent assault, relating to the same incident in 2001, has now been added to the indictment. 

The change relates to an allegation that Brand grabbed a female MTV worker by the arm and tried to drag her into a toilet. 

Brand faces three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault. He denies all the charges.

reports.title: 'She didn’t think she would be believed' friend of Russell Brand accuser tells court | Trial day 9
reports.description:
Warning: This episode includes graphic descriptions of rape and sexual assault. 
It's day 9 of Russell Brand's rape trial in London, and today the court heard from several witnesses relating to a woman who alleges she was anally raped by Russell Brand in 2009. 
A statement from the accuser's mother was read in court, in which she said 'I just remember her saying "he raped me"' and that 'she was very worried about HIV'.  
A friend of the alleged victim also told the court that the woman looked 'terrible' and 'ashen' when she revealed what allegedly happened at Brand’s home. The witness said she asked her friend if she had consented and her friend said ‘no, no, I did not consent to that.'  
Brand faces three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault. He denies all the charges.  
In today’s episode, Culture Correspondent Minnie Stephenson speaks to our producer Sachelle Connor about all the details from inside the courtroom and what the jury heard.

reports.title: 'When I asked him to stop, he didn’t', Brand accuser tells court | Trial day 7
reports.description:
Warning: This episode includes graphic descriptions of rape and sexual assault. 
It's day seven of Russell Brand's rape trial at Southwark Crown Court, and the testimonies of three more alleged victims were heard in court. The details were extremely graphic.  
One woman alleges that after she had consensual vaginal sex with Brand at his home he then anally raped her. She says she told Brand to stop, 'a few times quietly and then really loudly'.  
Another woman alleges that Brand groped and kissed her in what she described as a 'violent' sexual assault while she was working at a radio station. She described Brand as 'rough', 'violent' and 'persistent'. 
A third woman accuses Brand of sexually assaulting her during filming for a Channel 4 project in 2009. 
In today’s episode, Culture Correspondent Minnie Stephenson speaks to our producer Holly Snelling about all the details from inside the courtroom and what the jury heard. Brand faces three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault. He denies all the charges.

reports.title: Brand turned into a 'wide-eyed maniac' says second alleged victim | Trial Day 5
reports.description:
It's day 5 of Russell Brand's rape trial in London and  the second alleged victim took to the stand, along with other witnesses', including his former friend and flatmate Andrew Dobson.

In today’s episode, Culture Correspondent Minnie Stephenson speaks to our producer Sachelle Conner about all the details from inside the courtroom and what the jury heard today.

reports.title: Brand allegedly raped woman after asking her to photograph him, court hears

In today’s episode, Culture Correspondent Minnie Stephenson speaks to our producer Sachelle Conner about the testimony heard in court and the details that emerged during proceedings.

reports.title: Inside the courtroom: How a criminal trial works | Russell Brand on Trial
reports.description: Russell Brand will be on trial from Monday: he's been charged with three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault. He strenuously denies all charges. But how does the UK justice system ensure a fair trial when the defendant is one of the UK's most recognisable public figures? What does the prosecution have to prove in a case of this nature? And what protections are available to witnesses? In this episode, Minnie Stephenson speaks to Sir Max Hill KC, former Director of Public Prosecutions and one of Britain's most experienced criminal barristers, about how a trial like this unfolds. This is the first episode of our daily podcast bringing you the evidence and legal context from the courtroom as the trial unfolds.
